title: Company Closure now writes the EIN closure letter to the IRS, signed by the client
text: The IRS Closure step in the Company Closure workspace now makes the EIN closure letter for you, with the same wording as past closure letters, and puts a copy of the client's EIN letter behind it when there is one. The closure form the client fills in now has a box to draw their signature, and the letter uses it. The signature is required, so the form cannot be sent without it.
points: The return address on the letter is our Seminole office.
The letter fits on one page. If a name or address is too long, or has characters the letter cannot print, it says so instead of cutting text.
Closure forms the client had already sent before this keep the old way: a blank line to sign by hand.
